endpoints.fuzzy_beats_oracle_crispification_by_12_: fuzzy mid-blend MSE <= 0.08 times oracle-hard mid-blend MSE
endpoints.hardening_causes_at_least_30x_midblend_e: predicted-membership hardening MSE >= 30 times intact fuzzy MSE on held-out blends
endpoints.learned_hard_model_at_least_20x_worse: learned hard model mid-blend MSE >= 20 times fuzzy mid-blend MSE
endpoints.direct_edge_is_competitive: direct-edge mean MSE <= 1.10 times fuzzy mean MSE
endpoints.fuzzy_within_3x_direct_edge: fuzzy mean MSE <= 3 times direct-edge mean MSE
endpoints.entropy_separates_crisp_and_overlap: mean overlap entropy minus crisp entropy >= 0.45 and every seed >= 0.35
endpoints.idempotence_defect_separates_crisp_and_o: mean overlap defect minus crisp defect >= 0.25 and every seed >= 0.20
endpoints.idempotence_tracks_target_fuzziness: mean target correlation >= 0.85 and every seed >= 0.80
endpoints.membership_strength_is_causally_calibrat: mean ablation-effect correlation >= 0.45 and every seed >= 0.40
endpoints.high_membership_ablation_is_material: mean top-quartile ablation effect >= 0.02 and every seed >= 0.015
endpoints.oracle_hard_is_exact_only_on_crisp_tasks: mean oracle-hard crisp MSE <= 1e-7 and mean held-out blend MSE >= 0.02
endpoints.training_sharpens_crisp_but_retains_fuzz: mean crisp entropy falls by >= 0.10 from step 100 to 2000 and final fuzzy entropy exceeds final crisp entropy by >= 0.40
